_comment: Phase 6 measurement kit settings (D114, D115). Values marked [D] are protocol design choices fixed before any measurement; UNKNOWN values must be filled on the target machine, from the pinned HPAS README and a calibration run, and committed BEFORE the healthy campaign. The harness refuses to run anything that still contains UNKNOWN.

probe_params._comment: Work sizes are calibrated once on the target so that a healthy run takes about the planned cost (configs/phase5.yaml probes.cost_s), then frozen.
probe_params.cpu_work_iterations: UNKNOWN - calibrate: healthy run about 20 s
probe_params.pchase_bytes: UNKNOWN - calibrate: well above the last-level cache size of the target CPU
probe_params.pchase_steps: UNKNOWN - calibrate: healthy run about 20 s
